about: One symbol's legs (signed size, own entry price) and the answers two implementations must agree on. `rows`: vike_model::PositionStatusReport::from_legs (one direction is one BOTH row, both directions a LONG and a SHORT row, nothing open is the flat row). `net`: the sidecar's NetPosition.java over every leg (the per-fill `position` line). Each row is also NetPosition.java over that row's legs. Read by crates/bridges/dukascopy/tests/position_legs_golden.rs and jforex-bridge's NetPositionTest.

cases.name: two shorts weight their own entries
the remainder after a partial net close keeps its own entry
a mixed book is two rows; its net uses signed weighting
a fully hedged book is two rows; its net is flat with no basis
a locked pair keeps each side at its own entry
